spec: The canonical spelling of a LEGACY practice language selector. Four transforms, applied in this order: strings.ToLower, then "/" to "-", then " " to "-", then "+" to "plus". The authoritative implementation is store.SlugifyLanguage in cmd/knowledge-server/internal/store/language_detect.go; cmd/knowledge/internal/graphsel.SlugifyPracticeLanguage is the client's copy. This file is a DATA file, not a shared Go package: the two binaries are separate modules and share nothing hand-written, so a data file read by a test in EACH module is how the two copies are held to one rule. THE SUBJECT MOVED WHEN PRACTICE BECAME A SINGLETON: this table used to pin graphsel.CanonicalGraphName, because a practice graph's NAME was its slug. The combined practice graph is named "default" and CanonicalGraphName now puts practice in the singleton arm beside linkage and checks, asserted inline in the tests rather than here; these rows pin the transform that survives for the read-only `language` selector addressing the eight pre-singleton graphs. The filename is unchanged so no consumer has to move with the subject.
